description: This file implements diffing functions using the 'diff' library, specifically Myers diff algorithm for lines and characters, with custom processing for line and character differences.

methods.name: convertMyersChangeToDiffLines
methods.description: Converts a Change object from 'diff' library into an array of DiffLine objects, classifying each line as 'new', 'old', or 'same'.

methods.name: myersDiff
methods.description: Performs a line-based diff between oldContent and newContent, returning an array of DiffLine objects with detailed diff information.

methods.name: myersCharDiff
methods.description: Performs a character-based diff between oldContent and newContent, returning an array of DiffChar objects with detailed diff information, including handling of newlines.
